_comment: Canonical source-format capability vocabulary (CPDO-2.4, #4796) — the single source of truth the Python registry (apiome-rest/src/app/format_capability_registry.py) and its TypeScript mirror (apiome-ui/src/app/components/ade/dashboard/catalog/formatCapabilityRegistry.ts) are both asserted against, so the two cannot silently drift. Mirror tests: apiome-rest/tests/test_format_capability_registry.py and apiome-ui/tests/format-capability-registry.test.ts. `source_missing` must stay true on exactly one absence — a parser, capability, policy or content cause is never a missing source. `version_support` grades a declared format *version* (FMT-3.8): `full` reads/writes it head-on, `partial` reaches it through a stated projection or downgrade, `ungated` means the format carries no version marker the adapter branches on. Bump `registry_version` and `review_date` together with any change here.
